detail.longDescription: Beyond the Console: MCP and the New Operating Model for Enterprise Infrastructure NOC/SOC engineers waste ~70% of incident response time gathering data from fragmented tools. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes AI integration across vendors, with major players adopting MCP servers for unified access. An enterprise routing layer will correlate data across systems, boosting efficiency. Early adopters report faster resolution times. https:// versa-networks.com/blog/mcp-en terprise-infrastructure-zero-trust-governance/ # AI # MachineLearning # ITOps
